messages:
alex (AM): Quick sync — OrchidHealth asking for SOC2 assertion PDF, ISO scope excerpt, and a signed pen-test authorization letter before POC starts Wed. They want upload to a secure portal. Can we provide these by Tue EOD?
lucy (GTM): Procurement pushed for a single consolidated zip for legal. Also asked for a one-paragraph statement of isolation options for pricing (shared, dedicated, on-prem).
tara (SE): We can share SOC2 assertion + redacted controls matrix. ISO scope excerpt available but need to pull the specific service boundary doc from docs team. Pen-test letter: security needs NDA + window.
nina (Security): Correct. I can prepare a pen-test authorization template but must include required fields: signed NDA, exact test IPs, explicit allowed endpoints, and agreed rollback procedure. We do not allow active escalation testing without prior approval.
omar (Infra Ops): For staging scanner access, we can give a CIDR and ephemeral creds. Two notes: (1) ephemeral KMS roles require ticket and IAM TTL set (we usually do 12-24h), (2) if they want SFTP upload to our secure portal we need to provision a user and SFTP host key.
alex (AM): Customer prefers upload to our secure portal rather than shared drive. @omar can you prep the portal user + instructions?
omar (Infra Ops): Yup. I’ll create a temporary SFTP account and preseed the SSH fingerprint in the ticket. ETA 6 hours after ticket.
ben (Finance): Pricing note — single-tenant uplift ballpark: +$12k/month baseline for reserved infra; add-ons for on-prem-like isolation or guaranteed GPU reservations are incremental. If they ask for true air-gapped install, that's a separate private deployment contract.
lucy (GTM): Procurement wants a short doc explaining what each uplift covers (network isolation, dedicated machines, support SLA). Can someone draft a 2-3 bullet summary?
tara (SE): I'll draft bullets and include expected RPS/token ranges needed to firm up pricing.
nina (Security): Pen-test letter draft ready by EOD today if NDA lands. Also we'll append a redacted vulnerability disclosure contact.
evidence-bot: New ticket created: PORTAL-1987 (sftp user, portal upload) assigned to oiffice-infra.
alex (AM): Thanks — I'll send the NDA to OrchidHealth now and request preferred test window. If they insist on a Friday scan window, flag it here; we avoid scans on release days.
ben (Finance): Also reminder: include estimated monthly committed spend for procurement to sign off. If they want committed throughput, we need expected concurrency and daily token estimates.
lucy (GTM): I'll ask the customer for concurrency and daily throughput — will update here.
omar (Infra Ops): One more infra detail: if they ask for egress IP pinning, we provide a /29 for POC. Otherwise use our dynamic NAT pool.
alex (AM): Perfect. Action items: Nina — pen-test letter upon NDA; Omar — portal & SFTP user (PORTAL-1987); Tara — pricing bullets; Ben — formal uplifts for procurement. I'll update thread when NDA uploaded. :thumbsup:
